items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: And Major Y.R. Violet, there were gentlemen, the two of them. Fine men. Fine men. I stayed in there until they went to ship us over

ctx.x: Oh, you got to see that.

There's 35 or 36 men in this band here, he said, and they're all leaning to you. I said, I just said, well, I'll tell you this. He said, they want you. So, anyhow, I took over. You know, they all got on me, I took over. And, brother, when I got on the street with the military band, they played, they played one chorus and a voice, you know, one chorus and I'd follow in after. They'd stop. My band would then fill out. See? Then they'd start a game and I'd fill out, they'd start a game. It was that wonderful that I…
That's the picture. I didn't know where it was, really.
